title: Agent Ballot
description: A signed attestation bound to an exact commit and evidence root. INSTALLED BUT INERT: config/delegation_envelope.json sets ballot_layer.state = NOT_ACTIVE because five independent agents with separately enforced service identities do not exist in this deployment. No code enforces quorum. A ballot emitted today is evidence of reasoning, never authorization — one session producing five role-labelled ballots is self-approval in five hats, and role labels are self-asserted text. The schema exists so that the day distinct identities exist, the evidence format does not have to be invented under pressure.

subject_commit.description: Exact commit SHA. A new push changes this value and invalidates every ballot bound to the old one.

evidence_root.description: Merkle root over the evidence pack. Evidence expires with the commit.

signer_identity.description: Workload identity of the signer (e.g. an OIDC subject). MUST differ from the proposer's identity; a ballot whose signer cannot be distinguished from the proposer is void.

independence_attestation.description: Statement that this signer neither authored the change nor built its evidence.
